main_text.p: quando actor petit poenam sibi adjudicari: daturque actio in tantum, in quantum injuriatus eam astimaverit: ut cùm dicit in libello se malle tot vel tot aureos amittere, quàm ejusmodi injuria affici, secundum Mynsing. hic. Et Andreà Gaill. observat. 65. lib. 1.

head.bl: De obligationibus quae quasi ex delicto nascuntur. Von verpflichtungen, welche als auß Malefiz vnd vbelthat erwachsen.

head.i: Quot modis obligationes ex quasi delicto nascuntur?

main_text.p: Quatuor: primo, si judex litem suam fecerit: non proprie ex maleficio obligatus videtur: sed quia neq; ex maleficio, neq; ex contractu obligatus est, & utiq; peccasse aliquid intelligitur, licet per imprudentiam: ideo videtur quasi ex maleficio teneri, & in quantum de ea re aequum religioni judicantis videbitur, poenam sustinebit. in prin.inst eod.

Secudo,is,ex cujus coenaculo, vel proprio ipsius, vel conducto, vel in quo gratis habitat, dejectum effusumve aliquid est, ita ut alicui noceret, quasi ex maleficio obligatus intelligitur. §.item is.ex.inst eod.
Tertio,is quasi ex maleficio obligatur, qui ea parte, qua vulgò iter fieri solet, id positum aut suspensum habet, quod potest (si ceciderit) alicui nocere, §.1. verf.cui similis.inst.eod.

Quarto, exercitor navis aut cauponae aut stabuli de dolo aut furto, quod in navi aut caupona ut stabulo factum erit, quasi ex maleficio teneri videtur, si modo ipsius nullum est maleficium, sed alicujus co.ü[?],

page.notes: The top line is a continuation from the previous page and is set in smaller type; the first word "quando" is printed with a fragment of the line before. The subtitle is in black letter and was transcribed with [?] where the initial "V" of "Von" reads like "B". "aestimaverit" in the continuation line is uncertain (the ligature reads "a(s)timaverit"), so the [?] is placed accordingly. The last word of the final line is cut off by the foot of the page: "co.ü" is a guess at "comitis" and is marked [?]. The printed spellings "Secudo" and "Tertio" are as printed. A dark mark at the bottom centre of the scan is a stain or ink mark, not printed text, and is left out. The large initial "Q" of "Quatuor" is joined to the word. No catchword or signature is printed.
